technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot 3.x and Spring Framework 6.0, requiring Java 17+ as the baseline.
Implement the streaming pipeline components as Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) applications.
Design the Kinesis, Log, Field-value-counter, Aggregate-counter, Gauge, and Rich-gauge modules as sink applications.
Implement the Flink module as a processor application integrating Apache Flink's DataStream API.
For the Job DSL (U3), leverage Spring Cloud Data Flow (SCDF) DSL capabilities or implement a compatible parser to orchestrate workflows.
Use AWS SDK for Java v2 for the Kinesis sink integration.
assumptions: The developer has access to the legacy Spring XD source code to port the required modules.
The s-c-s repository and its base build/CI infrastructure already exist and are configured.
Testing environments for AWS Kinesis and Apache Flink are available to the developer.
The term 's-c-s' refers to Spring Cloud Stream.
The developer is familiar with Spring XD, Spring Cloud Stream, and Apache Flink.

activities.activity_description: Set up the development environment, define the architecture for the s-c-s modules, and establish the base project structure for all new sink and processor modules.
Develop the Kinesis sink module to allow data to be sent to Amazon Kinesis streams, including configuration properties and integration with AWS SDK.
Port the Log module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository, adapting it to the Spring Cloud Stream sink model.
Design and implement the Job DSL option to allow users to create comprehensive workflows and orchestrate jobs, ensuring compatibility with XD concepts where necessary.
Port the field-value-counter module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository as a sink application.
Port the aggregate-counter module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository as a sink application.
Port the gauge module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository as a sink application.
Port the rich-gauge module from Spring XD to the s-c-s repository as a sink application.
Develop the Flink processor module to enable data processing using Flink's streaming machine learning abstractions, integrating it with the s-c-s architecture.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing of all modules within a streaming pipeline context.
Write user guides, configuration documentation, and update README files for all newly implemented and ported modules.
